'''Makthierse''' was a colony world noted for ranches, [[Farm/Legends|farms]], crystal [[Cave/Legends|caves]], and [[Quantrax Creek]]. Native creatures included [[laca]]s and [[preying makthier]]s.<ref name="COG" />
